security_and_recovery.journey: The real filtered runner seeded a two-partition Redpanda topic with 64 JSON records, defined a durable table stream with batch_limit 4, observed initial lag 32/32, repeatedly ran the real API, checked monotonic lag and exact row counts, and reached lag zero with exactly 64 records consumed. The same campaign also reran the existing broker-restart checkpoint case. Cleanup removed the isolated broker and network.
security_and_recovery.negative_paths: The candidate retains the Kafka metadata-failure regression that prevents an unavailable broker from being reported as a successful idle result. The live journey retains expected 503 outage responses and WARN/error evidence; no provider outage was hidden or reclassified as a clean success.
security_and_recovery.provider_scope: Only the local Redpanda Kafka-compatible provider was exercised. No external Kafka provider, PostgreSQL-backed worker, continuous supervisor, long-duration soak or operator matrix is certified by this filtered diagnostic.

open_cells: P11 remains in_progress: D40 proves a bounded 64-record two-partition backlog drain with micro-batches capped at four, but not a sustained supervisor soak, continuous operation or long-duration recovery under pressure.
Only local Redpanda/Kafka is exercised; external Kafka/provider breadth, PostgreSQL-backed worker integration and the complete operator matrix remain open.
The archive browser lane remains SKIP when @playwright/test is not packaged; the live runner's external dependency cache is recorded separately and does not alter that archive scope.
D40 does not rerun the 43-minute full Python suite, image scans or license qualification; D38's exact product-code result remains explicitly linked rather than copied as new PASS.
P13 remains blocked by the external secret-provider and release-evidence boundary; P12 and P14 remain in_progress; no family other than the existing P1 is qualified.
No release gate is closed; release remains NO-GO at 1/13 families and 0/10 gates.
limitations: The backlog campaign is bounded by 64 seeded records and one-shot API runs; it does not certify a continuous supervisor, indefinite pressure handling or a throughput/SLO target.
The four WARN outcomes and three ERROR-level 503 records are expected negative-path evidence from the filtered live diagnostic; they were retained and correlated, not suppressed.

Artifact qualification temporarily wrote setuptools egg-info and bytecode caches into the candidate sandbox; targeted candidate cleanup removed them, regeneration restored the exact boundary and final verify passed with unchanged archive/manifest hashes.
No hosted workflow, GitHub Actions job, branch or worktree was used.
